title: DAY 1: NO ONE IS COMING
lessons: Water first: assume tap and flood water are unsafe; boil (rolling boil, 1 minute) or purify; a home water-heater tank is a hidden clean-water supply.
Don't go back into the flood zone: more waves (aftershocks), contaminated water, downed power lines, gas leaks, unstable buildings.
Never run a generator, grill or camp stove inside a tent, car or any enclosed space — carbon monoxide.
Ration food from day one (but drink the water you need) and keep supplies discreet — having what others lack changes how people treat you.

parts.title: The Morning After
parts.hook: The radio: relief may take days... possibly weeks.

scenes.title: Previously
scenes.action: RECAP of Day 0 (5 s, fast). NIGHT version of the Episode-1 hilltop: darken the whole frame (a night overlay over the background, a few flashlight beams and cold blue light), the crowd huddled under the canopy. In the distant flooded lowland (view), the water surges pale and pulses (view.setLevel up/down, white foam flashes) — the waves seen from above in the dark. Quick push-in toward the view. Drizzle (hood up, go-bag on) and Mags (radio, blanket over her shoulders) sit huddled together under the canopy edge, watching. A 'PREVIOUSLY' feel: slight film-flicker/vignette.
scenes.start: Night, crowd huddled; waves flashing below.
scenes.end: Drizzle and Mags huddled, watching the dark water.

captions.text: PREVIOUSLY: DAY 0
The quake. The waves. A long night on the hill.

scenes.title: Day One
scenes.action: Title open. 0–4 s: the 'RAINY DAY' title sting (yellow League Gothic, hand-drawn underline, like Episode 1's title) over the foggy camp, then a 'DAY 1' card (League Gothic, paper/yellow) with a small 'NO ONE IS COMING' subtitle; both fade out by ~4.5 s. Flat cold gray dawn; the fog layer slowly thins over the scene; drizzle (rain, low intensity). Townspeople (extras) stir: one wrings out a blanket, one stamps feet for warmth. Drizzle crawls out from under a tarp lean-to near the canopy (crouch → stand), hood up, go-bag on his back, shivers (small fast jitter) and stretches. Mags sits on a camp chair with a blanket over her shoulders and her radio on her knee, deadpan. Slow camera drift.
scenes.start: Fog, camp asleep; title over it.
scenes.end: Drizzle standing, stretching; Mags in her chair.

captions.text: Morning came cold and gray. Nobody had really slept.

captions.speaker: DRIZZLE
captions.text: Good news. I'm still waterproof.

captions.speaker: MAGS
captions.text: Bad news. Nothing else is.

scenes.title: The View Down
scenes.action: Drizzle walks to the hill lip (from left), Mags follows; two or three extras already stand at the edge, silent. Wide vista of the wrecked, flooded town. Slow push-in toward the town; at ~4.5 s a slight drift toward the stranded ferry on Main Street; at ~13.8 s the camera pans/drifts right to the broken Gull Creek BRIDGE on the coast highway and holds; at ~17 s pull back to the wide empty sky — no boats, no helicopters, no cars on the road. Drizzle points at the ferry; later looks up at the sky hopefully (lookUp), then his shoulders drop. Light rain. Gulls (tiny ink Vs) circle over the water.
scenes.end: Both standing at the lip; Drizzle deflated.

captions.text: Below them, Gull Harbor was gone.

captions.speaker: DRIZZLE
captions.text: Mags... the ferry's on Main Street.

captions.speaker: MAGS
captions.text: So is half the harbor.

captions.speaker: DRIZZLE
captions.text: Someone'll come, right? Helicopters? Coast Guard?

captions.speaker: MAGS
captions.text: Look at the bridge.
No boats. No helicopters. No one on the road.

scenes.title: Nobody's Coming
scenes.action: The camp, restless. Extras look at the sky and the road, pace; a woman (extra, NEIGHBOR) hugs herself, another (NEIGHBOR) answers. At ~6.6 s GORD PIKE (new character: big, flat cap, puffy vest, CLIPBOARD) climbs up onto the picnic table and raises the clipboard; the crowd turns toward him. He gestures broadly while he talks. Drizzle and Mags stand at the left side of the crowd; at ~14 s Mags leans toward Drizzle and speaks quietly (small head tilt), Drizzle glances at her.
scenes.start: Crowd pacing; Gord near the table.
scenes.end: Gord standing on the table; crowd facing him; Mags beside Drizzle.

captions.speaker: NEIGHBOR
captions.text: It's been a whole night. Where is everybody?

captions.speaker: NEIGHBOR
captions.text: They'll come. They have to.

captions.speaker: GORD
captions.text: Folks! Listen up! Help is on its way.

captions.speaker: GORD
captions.text: Till then, we stay calm and organized.

captions.speaker: MAGS
captions.text: He doesn't know that. Nobody does.

scenes.title: Static
scenes.action: Under the canopy: Mags sits and cranks her radio (crank arm circling, visible static squiggle lines from the speaker); the crowd presses in around her in a half circle, Gord at the back with his clipboard, Drizzle kneeling next to Mags. Camera slowly pushes in on the radio and the faces as each fragment lands. After the last fragment (~13.6 s) the static cuts and the whole crowd freezes; dead silence beat; Drizzle looks up at Mags (worried face). End close on Drizzle.

captions.text: KRRSHHH—

captions.speaker: RADIO
captions.text: ...the entire coast, Oregon to British Columbia...

captions.speaker: RADIO
captions.text: ...roads and bridges impassable... Highway 101...

captions.speaker: RADIO
captions.text: ...relief may take days... possibly weeks...

captions.speaker: DRIZZLE
captions.text: ...Weeks?

parts.title: Water First
parts.hook: Every eye on Drizzle's open go-bag.

scenes.title: Panic
scenes.action: The crowd erupts: extras turn to each other, arms up, pacing fast. A man (NEIGHBOR) runs to a car parked on the grass at the edge, gets in; the car rocks, its rear wheel spins in mud throwing mud spatter and goes nowhere. Mags walks to the car and says her line through the window. TESS VARGA (new character: beanie with pom, ponytail, long dark coat, big padlocked DUFFEL) pulls her duffel close and puts an arm around her son MILO (a kid extra) at the side of the frame. At ~14 s Drizzle grabs a folded tarp and a bucket from the canopy and holds them up with a determined face.
scenes.end: Drizzle holding up a tarp and a bucket.

captions.speaker: NEIGHBOR
captions.text: Weeks?! We'll be dead in weeks!

captions.speaker: NEIGHBOR
captions.text: I'm driving out. I'm not waiting.

captions.speaker: MAGS
captions.text: Drive where? There's no road left.
Fear spreads fast when there's nothing to do.

captions.speaker: DRIZZLE
captions.text: Okay. Then let's do something.

scenes.title: Water First
scenes.action: The shelter set. A neighbor (extra) kneels at a muddy runoff puddle at the front, cupping water toward his mouth; at 0.6 s Mags hurries in and stops him (hand up), he stands. Then Drizzle and Mags rig the rain catch: Drizzle stretches the tarp corner so the sag drips into the bucket (animate drips falling from the sag into the bucket, the bucket level rising), Mags sets a pot on the grate over the fire ring OUTSIDE the tarp (small flames, steam). When the sign appears (~15.4 s) the pot comes to a rolling boil (bubbles, steam).
scenes.end: Rain catch dripping, pot boiling on the fire.

captions.speaker: MAGS
captions.text: Don't drink that!

captions.speaker: NEIGHBOR
captions.text: It's just rainwater.

captions.speaker: MAGS
captions.text: It's runoff. Sewage, fuel, chemicals.

captions.speaker: DRIZZLE
captions.text: What about the cabin tap?

captions.speaker: MAGS
captions.text: Pipes broke. Catch rain clean, then boil it.
WATER FIRST: TAP AND FLOOD WATER ARE UNSAFE — BOIL OR PURIFY

scenes.title: Not in the Tent
scenes.action: A dad (extra) carries a lit camp stove (small flame) toward the dome tent, where his kid (kid extra) shivers in the open door. Drizzle spots it and points. Mags hurries over, steps between the dad and the tent, takes the stove and carries it back out into the open next to the fire ring (outside, away from the tent and tarp). Then she wraps the kid in her blanket (give the blanket over). Calm but firm acting; the dad nods, chastened.
scenes.start: Dad walking toward the tent with the stove.
scenes.end: Stove outside by the fire ring; kid wrapped in Mags' blanket.

captions.speaker: NEIGHBOR
captions.text: My boy's freezing. Just for a few minutes.

captions.speaker: DRIZZLE
captions.text: Mags— the stove!

captions.speaker: MAGS
captions.text: Not in there. Not ever.

captions.speaker: MAGS
captions.text: Carbon monoxide. You can't see it or smell it.
NEVER RUN A STOVE, GRILL OR GENERATOR IN A TENT, CAR OR ANY ENCLOSED SPACE

scenes.title: The Count
scenes.action: At the picnic table. Gord stands behind it with his clipboard, writing. Extras step up and put a few things on the table: three water bottles, a bag of chips, a lighter, a phone (draw these props on the table as they appear). Gord's face goes from expectant to grim. At ~10 s Drizzle steps up, unzips his go-bag on the table to add a granola bar — the open bag reveals water pouches, food bars, a water filter, a flashlight, a first-aid kit (draw them peeking out). At ~13 s the crowd's heads ALL turn toward Drizzle (every extra faces him); Drizzle freezes with the granola bar in hand, awkward smile. Gord leans over the table toward him at ~16 s. Slow push-in on Drizzle and the open bag.
scenes.start: Gord at the table, crowd lining up.
scenes.end: All eyes on Drizzle and the open go-bag.

captions.speaker: GORD
captions.text: Okay. Everything you brought — on the table.
Most people had run with nothing but their phones.

captions.speaker: GORD
captions.text: Three waters. Chips. A lighter. That's it?

captions.speaker: DRIZZLE
captions.text: I've got... a granola bar to add!
Everyone saw what else was in the bag.

captions.speaker: GORD
captions.text: Well, well. What've you got there, Drizzle?

parts.title: Mine
parts.hook: Gord: Dale's store has a whole pallet of water.

scenes.title: Pool It
scenes.action: Continuous from s09: a half circle of the crowd around Drizzle at the table; Gord taps the clipboard on his palm. A neighbor steps forward, pointing at Drizzle. Drizzle clutches the bag's strap (bag back on his back), shrinking. At ~12.8 s Mags steps in between Drizzle and Gord, radio in hand, calm and immovable; the crowd shifts back half a step. Tension: slow push-in, the extras' heads turn between speakers.
scenes.start: Crowd around Drizzle, bag open on the table.
scenes.end: Mags standing between Drizzle and Gord; crowd backed off a step.

captions.speaker: GORD
captions.text: One pile. I ration it. Fair for everyone.

captions.speaker: NEIGHBOR
captions.text: Yeah! Why should he keep it?

captions.speaker: DRIZZLE
captions.text: I want to help, but who decides who gets what?

captions.speaker: GORD
captions.text: I do. Somebody has to.

captions.speaker: MAGS
captions.text: Nobody takes anything from anybody. Not today.
Yesterday they were neighbors. Today they were counting.

scenes.title: The Duffel
scenes.action: At the camp edge by the tents (fewer extras). Tess sits on her padlocked duffel (sit pose), Milo (kid extra) beside her. Gord walks up with two followers (extras) behind him, clipboard raised. Tess stands up slowly, grips the duffel strap, faces him: a standoff, neither moves. Gord leans in on his last line. In the background at left, Drizzle and Mags watch; at 14.6 s Drizzle says his line quietly to Mags.
scenes.start: Tess sitting on the duffel; Gord approaching.
scenes.end: Tess and Gord face to face; Drizzle and Mags watching.

captions.speaker: GORD
captions.text: You too, Tess. What's in the bag?

captions.speaker: TESS
captions.text: Mine. For my son.

captions.speaker: GORD
captions.text: There's no 'mine' anymore. Not up here.

captions.speaker: TESS
captions.text: Says the man holding the list.

captions.speaker: GORD
captions.text: We'll talk later. Everybody shares.

captions.speaker: DRIZZLE
captions.text: She looks like I feel.

scenes.title: Quietly
scenes.action: Under the tarp, later. Drizzle sits on his sleeping bag; Mags on the crate. Drizzle takes the go-bag off and tucks it under the sleeping bag at the bag spot, pulls the sleeping bag over it (out of sight). Mags breaks a food bar in half and hands him one half (rationing). Rain drips from the sag into the bucket. Quiet, intimate framing; slow push-in.
scenes.end: Bag hidden under the sleeping bag; each with half a bar.

captions.speaker: MAGS
captions.text: Ration the food from day one.

captions.speaker: DRIZZLE
captions.text: And the water?

captions.speaker: MAGS
captions.text: Drink what you need. Then find more.

captions.speaker: MAGS
captions.text: And keep that bag out of sight. People notice.
RATION FOOD FROM DAY ONE. KEEP SUPPLIES OUT OF SIGHT.

scenes.title: Hidden Water
scenes.action: Milo (kid extra) wanders up to the tarp; Drizzle quietly slips him a granola bar (finger to lips). Then Mags leads Drizzle to the cabin's open utility shed and points at the WATER HEATER. Drizzle crouches at the drain valve with the bucket; clear water runs from the valve into the bucket (animate the stream). At ~16 s, in the background on the camp side (left/back), Gord appears raised up (on a crate or the table edge), arm up, shouting his line; Drizzle and Mags turn their heads toward him.
scenes.end: Water filling the bucket; both looking toward Gord.

captions.speaker: DRIZZLE
captions.text: Shh. Our secret. Eat it slow.

captions.speaker: MAGS
captions.text: Every house up here has a hidden water tank.

captions.speaker: DRIZZLE
captions.text: The water heater? That's forty gallons!

captions.speaker: MAGS
captions.text: Power off. Open the drain. Clean water.
HIDDEN WATER: A WATER HEATER HOLDS 30–80 GALLONS

captions.speaker: GORD
captions.text: Listen up! Dale's store has a whole pallet of water!

parts.title: Down the Hill
parts.hook: Black smoke over Dale's — and Drizzle's go-bag is gone.

scenes.title: Against the Warning
scenes.action: By the trailhead at the camp edge. Gord, clipboard under his arm, picks volunteers: three extras step forward (one is a Pruitt twin: cap + rain jacket, mist coat). Mags stands in front of Gord blocking the way, radio in hand, and makes her case (pointing down the hill on 'Lines are down'). Gord steps around her. On the sign (~14 s) the group of four walks off downhill (exit right/down), Gord leading; Drizzle takes a step after them and Mags puts a hand on his chest — he stops.
scenes.end: The group gone downhill; Mags holding Drizzle back.

captions.speaker: GORD
captions.text: Four of us. In and out before lunch.

captions.speaker: MAGS
captions.text: Into the flood zone? Any aftershock can send another wave.

captions.speaker: MAGS
captions.text: Lines down. Gas leaking. Walls cracked.

captions.speaker: GORD
captions.text: People are thirsty. I won't wait weeks.
STAY OUT OF THE FLOOD ZONE

scenes.title: Dale's
scenes.action: Cutaway down in town, no Drizzle/Mags. Gord and three volunteers (one is PRUITT) wade in across the flooded lot (water to the shins, ripples). Pruitt sniffs the air, worried. The downed power line lies across the lot into a puddle; Pruitt holds an arm out to stop another volunteer from stepping near it. Gord and a volunteer wrench the jammed store door (it scrapes open in jerks); the tilted canopy creaks and sways slightly. Faint shimmer lines (fuel vapor) rise from the sheen. On the sign, a tiny blue-white SPARK crackles where the downed line touches the water near the sheen — hold on it as the scene ends (no explosion yet). Tension: slow push-in.
scenes.end: Door forced open; a spark at the downed line.

captions.text: Dale's Gas & Grocery. The flood zone.

captions.speaker: PRUITT
captions.text: Gord... you smell that?

captions.speaker: GORD
captions.text: Just grab the water. Fast.

captions.speaker: PRUITT
captions.text: Watch the wire! Stay out of that puddle!

captions.speaker: GORD
captions.text: Pallet's right inside. Get the door open.
TREAT EVERY DOWNED LINE AS LIVE. IF YOU SMELL GAS, GET OUT.

scenes.title: Smoke
scenes.action: Drizzle, Mags and Milo (kid extra) at the hill lip, looking down at the tiny figures near Dale's. At ~7.4 s: a bright FLASH at the gas station (whiteout pop, then orange-free — use paper/fog whites, no yellow), a camera shake (RD.shake), and a column of thick BLACK SMOKE billows up from the station and keeps rising and spreading for the rest of the scene. Drizzle steps forward (scared), Mags grabs his arm. Milo hides behind Drizzle. No people visible hurt — the figures in town are too small to see; just smoke.
scenes.end: Black smoke rising over the town; Mags holding Drizzle's arm.

captions.speaker: DRIZZLE
captions.text: Water first. Stoves outside. Ration. Stay out of the flood zone.

captions.speaker: MAGS
captions.text: Tell that to Gord.
Dale's Gas & Grocery went up in black smoke.

captions.speaker: DRIZZLE
captions.text: No. No, no, no—

captions.speaker: MAGS
captions.text: Stay here. Nobody else goes down. Nobody.

scenes.title: Gone
scenes.action: Drizzle runs back into the shelter (from right), drops to his knees at the bag spot and throws back the sleeping bag — the go-bag is GONE (empty spot, a torn flap of the tarp swinging, muddy boot prints leading away). He searches frantically (looks under the crate, around the cars). Mags arrives behind him. Far in the background the black smoke column rises over the hill edge. Final beat: Drizzle sits back on his heels, staring at the empty spot; slow push-in on his face. 'NEXT: DAY 1 · NIGHT' sting at the end (League Gothic, paper/yellow like Episode 1's 'NEXT: DAY 1').
scenes.end: Drizzle on his heels at the empty spot; smoke beyond; NEXT sting.

captions.speaker: DRIZZLE
captions.text: First-aid kit. They'll need it—

captions.speaker: DRIZZLE
captions.text: ...Where's my bag?

captions.speaker: DRIZZLE
captions.text: It was right here. Right HERE.

captions.speaker: MAGS
captions.text: Who knew where you kept it?

captions.speaker: DRIZZLE
captions.text: ...Everyone saw it.
Smoke below. An empty spot. No one coming.
NEXT: DAY 1 · NIGHT
